# GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. This is a small Eleventy static site, so every page is plain HTML and I read all of it. Four things cost points: the canonical address, a missing `lang`, a broken structured-data block, and a noindex on your Services page. These results are read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point canonical tags at your real domain - **Why it matters:** A canonical is the tag telling search tools which address is the official one for a page. Every page names a staging host, which tells them your real site isn't the official one. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small. Change the host to `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, the origin in `geo.config.json` and the sitemap. - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 2. Add `lang` to the page and a description to the Team page - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells tools which language the page is in. The Team page also has no description, so it has no summary for search results. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:2-4` - **What the code says:** `` and a front matter with only `title: Meet the team` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 3. Fix the broken structured data on the Contact page - **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is machine-readable facts about your business. The block has a trailing comma, so it's invalid JSON and will be ignored. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small. Remove the comma. - **Score after this:** 81/100 Each of these adds 2 points on its own. Doing all three plus the Services noindex fix brings the score to 100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `src/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /`; policy is allow | | GEO-014 | Listed pages are indexable | Problem | `src/services.njk:5` `noindex: true`; 3 of 4 routes clear | | GEO-015 | Canonical on the real origin | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`, all routes | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy static build | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | `src/contact.njk:10` | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `src/sitemap.xml`, `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt | | GEO-012 | Title, description, `lang` | Problem | `base.njk:2` no `lang`; `team.njk` no description | | GEO-016 | Pages reachable by links | Clear | `base.njk:12` nav with `` | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | Only element-level `data-nosnippet` (`contact.njk:8`) | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Read `base.njk` and `index.njk`: image has alt, links have text, titles set | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No mobile app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not present; not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app; not scored | ## Other problems found - **Services page is hidden but promoted:** `src/services.njk:5`: `noindex: true`. The page is in the sitemap (`src/sitemap.xml:4`) and the main nav, so search engines are told to skip your main commercial page. Remove the line, unless the hiding is deliberate. If it is, also remove the page from the sitemap. ## Worth considering - **Back up the "thousands of patients" claim:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients.` Add something concrete, such as years open, a review count or a source. - **Show the prices:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` No prices appear. List fees or "from" prices per treatment. - **Give each treatment its own page:** `src/services.njk:8`: `
  • Check-ups
  • Hygiene
    • …`. Pages like `/services/implants/` could answer questions such as cost, process and recovery. - **Name the dentists:** `src/team.njk:6`: `Our experienced dentists have decades of experience…` Add names, roles and qualifications. This is what the page promises but doesn't deliver. - **Enrich the Dentist structured data:** `src/contact.njk:7`: `Call 0113 496 0000 or visit 12 Park Row, Leeds.` Add `address`, `openingHours` and `url` to the JSON-LD. Also add opening hours as visible text. - **Add site identity data:** `src/_includes/base.njk:6`: `…| Brightside Dental` Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD with the name and URL. - **Add social tags:** `src/_includes/base.njk:7`. There are no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image` tags. They might help links preview well. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3`: `…/`. The sitemap is hand-kept. Eleventy could generate it with dates. - **Link from Services to Contact:** `src/services.njk:9`. Other pages link onward only through the nav, so a booking link would help visitors. ## Can't tell from code - **Live-only checks:** whether robots.txt, the sitemap URLs and the canonical targets really answer 200, and any `X-Robots-Tag` headers set by your host. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. - `https://www.brightside-dental.example` is the real domain, per `geo.config.json`, and the staging canonical is a mistake. - I left `thanks.njk` out of the sampled routes. It's noindex and not linked or in the sitemap, which looks deliberate. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-015`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
